senses.gloss: f. h. same, esp. trembling, disconnected note (staccato).—Pl. יַבָּבוֹת.
units: R. Hash. IV, 9 the value of a T’ruah כשלש י׳ (תרועה) is equal to three disconnected short notes.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 32:2">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 102:11">Yalk. Gen. 102</cite>.
